title: Hypothyroidism in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: Therefore, for early detection of hypothyroidism in children with type 1 diabetes, it is suggested to measure anti-thyroid antibodies and thyroid stimulating hormone at disease onset and in yearly intervals after the age of 12 yr. Furthermore, the International Society for Pediatric and Adolescent Diabetes Consensus Clinical Guidelines recommend the screening of thyroid function by analysing circulating thyroid stimulating hormone at the diagnosis of diabetes and, thereafter every 2nd yr. in asymptomatic individuals without goitre and more frequent if goitre present .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Children with type 1 diabetes aging between 8 - 15 y .

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Cases with hyperthyroidism .
2. Areas known to have endemic goitre due to nutritional iodine deficiency .
3. History of maternal hypothyroidism and / or congenital hypothyroidism .
4. Children known to be normoglycaemic with already presented thyroid dysfunction .
5. Children with multiple endocrinopathies .
6. Children under treatment with drugs inducing hypothyroidism like amiodarone , lithium .
7. Children under treatment with drugs affecting insulin secretion like steroids , growth hormone therapy .
study_population: The study will be applied on children with type 1 diabetes attending Diabetes Clinic at Sidy Galal Health Assurance Clinic in Assuit , aging between 8 - 15 yrs .
